TITLE: The Keep-Word Detective
HOOK: Can you crack the clue and find the best word to keep?
MISSION: Four words are hiding in the scene. Some belong in KEEP and some belong in LET GO. Sort them and unlock the word Ganesha wants you to remember.
SCENE_INSTRUCTION: Spot the four hidden words, then sort them carefully.
SORT_PROMPT: Which words help you grow, and which words should you let go?

CLUE_2: LET GO words do not belong in the answer.
CLUE_3: Read the KEEP letters from top to bottom.
